| description = Tundra Jack says, 'Megan? Just a young warrior of the Wolves of the North. She sorta likes hangin' around ol' Tundra Jack. Must be my good looks.'

We learn from Renth McLanis that Renth was ordered to personally escort the young warrior, Megan (the courier). Megan was sent to fetch the remains of Warrior Guildmaster Kylan O'Danos' deceased cousin, Ivan McMannus. Renth guzzling spirits at McDaniels forgot. Having lost the courier, Megan (and so the remains of Kylan's cousin) Renth sends you to Arnis McLish. for directions to Megan, and find out from her where Ivan's remains are. I think Renth is scared of Tundra Jack!

Arnis McLish says 'I heard she got lost on the plains. You should go ask her dog, Snowflake, where she is. I hear he is somewhere around the pass to Halas.'

Snowflake says 'Ruff.. Ruff.. Woof..'

Megan OReilly says 'Brrrr.. It.. Is sooo.. c-cold!! I never.. sh-should've j-joined.. the.. the W-wolves of the N-north!!'
